explanation: In Russia, pointing with the index finger is considered rude and aggressive, especially when directed at a person. It is associated with accusatory or commanding behavior, and polite Russians prefer to gesture with an open hand or nod their head to indicate a direction or person.
local_tip: Instead of pointing, use your whole hand with palm facing up or simply tilt your head in the desired direction.

also_check.note: Pointing with the index finger is very rude; use an open hand instead.
Pointing with the index finger is common and generally acceptable in casual settings.
Pointing with the index finger is considered impolite; use the thumb or a closed fist with thumb extended.
